name: Nextcloud Deck
tagline: Kanban boards from your Nextcloud, on your phone
description:
Nextcloud Deck puts your Deck boards in your pocket, so you can move cards along, tick things off and jot a note while you are away from a computer. Boards, lists, cards, labels, comments and attachments all work the way they do in the browser.

Everything lives on your own Nextcloud, and the app keeps a copy on the phone so you can carry on with no signal and sync later. Add more than one account if you use several servers.

This is a companion app, not a standalone to-do list. You need a Nextcloud server with the Deck app switched on, and the official Nextcloud Android app installed to handle signing in.
